entities.summary: Zhiying "Tania" Zeng is a Chinese-Chilean table tennis player. Born in China, she represents Chile internationally. She was part of the Chinese team prior to moving to Chile. She had a long break and returned to table tennis as a competitor during the COVID-19 pandemic. She competed in the women's singles event at the 2024 Summer Olympics and represented Chile in the sport, but lost in the preliminary round and did not advance.
